kai: Quick follow-up to RFC #342 (dashboard tile multiplexing). Ran a few load tests this morning and saw ~2x CPU on the query layer for p95 when dashboards have >50 tiles. Anyone else seeing this?

maria: Hmm. Can you paste the flamegraph? :thinking: 

kai: https://grafana.redwood/prod/flame/abc123 — the spike is around the multiplexer goroutine group.

aj: Saw similar in canary. Multiplexing collapses DB calls but we add JSON marshalling + per-tile planning. Net win for throughput but hurts tail latency in some cases.

sahil: To add — the HTTP client threadpool spawns more goroutines during multiplexing which increases syscall churn under high concurrency.

jenna: From product: our interactive SLOs are p50 200ms, p95 600ms. If multiplexing breaks p95 we need a fallback strategy pre-emptively.

kai: I instrumented payloads and found heterogeneous tiles (some big charts returning >8kb) cause extra gzip + marshalling. Patch idea: only multiplex tiles with small payloads or explicit cacheable flag.

aj: +1. Proposed rule set:
- multiplex if tile.response_size < 8kb AND tile.cacheable == true
- otherwise route single request (no multiplex)

sahil: Also propose a small in-memory kv-cache at the multiplexer layer to dedupe identical subqueries inside a dashboard render. Low-risk and should cut DB thrash.

maria: Can we make this per-tenant config so we can gate? e.g., `dashboard.multiplex.enabled` and `dashboard.multiplex.max_payload_bytes`.

kai: Yep. Quick guard sketch: ```go
// guard in multiplexer
if tile.Size > cfg.MaxPayloadBytes || !tile.Cacheable {
  return fetchTileDirect(tile)
}
return multiplexer.Fetch(tile)
```

jenna: Rollout plan? Need product sign-off before enabling for enterprise customers.

maria: Suggested rollout:
1) feature-flag default OFF
2) enable for internal orgs + 3 low-latency tenants
3) measure p50/p95 + CPU-per-node for 2 weeks
4) rollback if p95 > baseline + 15%

aj: Also add metrics: `dashboard.multiplex.collapsed_requests`, `dashboard.multiplex.serial_time_ms`, `dashboard.multiplex.fallback_rate`.

sahil: Suggest adding a heuristics endpoint so frontend can decide rendering strategy: `/v1/dashboards/:id/multiplex-plan` returning which tiles will be multiplexed in the plan.

kai: Good call — I'll add that endpoint to the patch.

kai: Action items:
- kai: PR with guard + heuristics endpoint (due Thu)
- aj: add metrics + grafana dashboards (due Fri)
- sahil: kv-cache prototype and http threadpool tuning (due next Wed)
- maria: feature flag + rollout doc (due Mon)

deploy-bot: New canary created: `dashboard-multiplexer` -> infra-canary-2 at 1815000300 :rocket:

jenna: Thanks — ping me after 48h of canary data.

aj: I'll monitor.

maria: tagging ops: @ops — please watch the canary's p95.

ops: noted. will alert if p95 > 650ms.

kai: Thanks all. I'll open the PRs and link back here.
